analysis.reasonEn: Maintained a wait-and-see approach for the past 3 sessions. RSI failed to exit oversold territory, and MACD histogram continues to worsen. ADX at 27.1 indicates no clear trend, making premature entry risky. Despite a +6.03% move yesterday, the price remains below the 20-day moving average ($29,174). A break below the swing support at $26,385 could signal further downside.
